description: Pale marble on every wall and warm stone underfoot, with a cove of light round the ceiling instead of a lamp. The walk-in shower is behind frameless glass against black marble, and a frosted slot up high carries the weather. A wide mirror over the walnut vanity is lit from behind. The door seals with a soft sigh.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot

name: Residence 10-A en-suite
